prior_repair.change: Added soundfile==0.13.1 to the disposable comparator Python environment after run 33340366984 failed because datasets audio encoding required soundfile.

root_cause.meaning: The selected FLEURS fixture bytes are WAV format tag 3 (IEEE float). The comparator writes those source bytes directly to .wav and validate_wav() opens them with Python wave, whose validation path expects PCM-compatible WAV. The comparator therefore exits during fixture preparation before Nemotron transcription executes.

repair_requirement.minimal_delta: Make fixture preparation explicitly decode the exact bound FLEURS source audio and emit deterministic mono 16 kHz PCM16 WAV fixtures before validate_wav/gate/transcription, while retaining the original source-audio hash and separately hashing the normalized PCM fixture.

rewrite measured values to satisfy the current F2 validator

receipt_contract_fence.note: Even after fixture decoding is repaired, the controller receipt envelope/classification still requires explicit reconciliation with the current F2 fail-closed validator before promotion. A successful raw comparator run alone does not resolve that separate contract mismatch.

next_exact_action: Repair only the controller fixture decoder/normalizer so exact bound FLEURS float WAV source material becomes deterministic PCM16 input with dual source/normalized hashes; then execute one new exact comparator subject and preserve raw evidence.
